text: PR #5428 (#5426, migrate runtime_pipeline_launcher_artifact_inventory.cpp) merged as 167cf3f2a after 3 review rounds beyond the original migration, all catching real issues: round 1 (bot review on the PR itself, not agent-channel) found the handle-based read never re-verifies the path still resolves to the checked object after the read -- fixed with an independent post-read inspect_physical_path_containment() re-walk, mirroring what the string-reopening function it replaced did; round 2 found that re-walk used the raw pre-walk path instead of the already-verified canonical_path (not actually mirroring the old function despite the claim) and had no dedicated regression test -- fixed both, added a macro-gated test hook + test_launcher_artifact_admission_rejects_rename_during_read(), verified it catches the regression; round 3 found the re-walk used full identity comparison (including link_count) contradicting this call site's own documented lack of a link_count invariant, risking spurious build failures on benign transient link_count changes -- fixed to use content_equal() instead, matching the comment and content_equal()'s original design intent. Deferred two follow-ups as tracked issues rather than expanding scope mid-review: #5434 (extract a shared read-and-revalidate-path helper, will also serve #5427) and #5435 (this function's generic error code + no retry across 6 failure modes, confirmed pre-existing not a regression). Issue #5426 closed. Also received a broad architecture/code-review report from another reviewer (agy) confirming overall design quality and cross-referencing the same issue queue -- nothing new to act on beyond what's already tracked. Starting #5427 (polyglot_supporting_artifact_admission.cpp's admit_polyglot_supporting_artifact() check-then-read pair) now.
